name: RDPEGFX Shortcomings Closure
description: Ralph-ready work plan generated from PLAN_IMPLEMENTATION_SHORTCOMINGS.md to close remaining RDPEGFX/viewer-server implementation gaps: ACK suspend handling, monitor layout fidelity, safer GFX fallback, pointer transport/forwarding, runtime metrics coverage, RFX codec work, validation evidence, and remaining deferred production TODOs.

userStories.title: Audit and complete RDPEGFX runtime metrics
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the RDPEGFX and classic publishing paths to expose the metrics listed in the implementation plan so latency, stale updates, and slow-viewer behavior can be diagnosed with logs and counters.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit existing metrics/logging against PLAN_IMPLEMENTATION_SHORTCOMINGS.md metric list: queued update count, queued bytes, dirty rect count/area, coalesced/dropped count, send start/end timestamp, max send-call duration, last framebuffer generation sent, latest framebuffer generation available, backend update timestamp, framebuffer update timestamp, publisher enqueue timestamp, and viewer send timestamp.
Add missing counters or timestamps in the owning modules without holding framebuffer or global server locks during FreeRDP sends.
Update or add unit tests for any new metric/counter behavior that can be tested without real clients.
Document any metric that cannot be captured reliably and explain why in a task or docs file.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: added framebuffer last-update timestamps, publisher dirty area/enqueue/drop-byte/timestamp metrics, per-viewer last send start/end timestamps, classic transport send timestamp propagation, and RDPEGFX dirty/baseline send timing plus dirty rect count/area metrics. Updated test build wiring for platform timestamp dependency. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, and git diff --check passed.

userStories.title: Handle RDPEGFX acknowledgement suspension
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RDPEGFX acknowledgement suspension to be handled explicitly so a client that suspends frame acknowledgements cannot corrupt dirty pacing or block unrelated viewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm the FreeRDP 3.26 RDPEGFX FrameAcknowledge callback semantics and identify how SUSPEND_FRAME_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT / 0xFFFFFFFF is exposed to OmniRDP.
Add explicit handling for acknowledgement suspension when the protocol exposes it, without treating the suspend value as a normal frame acknowledgement.
Suspended acknowledgement state must be per viewer only and must not disable GFX or dirty updates for unrelated viewers.
Resize, reconnect, baseline reset, or GFX session reset clears stale suspended-ACK state for that viewer.
Add tests covering suspend handling, stale suspend state across reset, and normal ACK behavior after suspension clears.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: confirmed FreeRDP RDPGFX_FRAME_ACKNOWLEDGE_PDU exposes queueDepth with SUSPEND_FRAME_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT. Added explicit per-viewer acknowledgement-suspension state, PDU-level ACK handling, suspension-aware dirty pacing, reset clearing, and tests covering suspend handling, per-viewer isolation, resume via nonzero queue depth, and reset cleanup. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, and git diff --check passed.

userStories.title: Expose monitor layout to viewer GFX baseline code
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the RDPEGFX baseline path to have access to actual monitor layout data so ResetGraphics can represent one-monitor and multi-monitor sessions accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the authoritative monitor layout source currently used by backend/viewer configuration.
Add a narrow internal API or snapshot structure that gives viewer_gfx_pipeline the current monitor count and monitor rectangles without exposing unrelated viewer_server internals.
The monitor layout snapshot must include primary-monitor flags and dimensions needed to build RDPGFX_RESET_GRAPHICS_PDU.
Existing one-monitor behavior remains unchanged when monitor count is one.
Add unit tests for monitor layout snapshot creation or translation where feasible.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: identified server->monitor_layout as the viewer-side authoritative layout snapshot copied from backend monitor_layout. Added viewer_gfx_pipeline_monitor_layout_snapshot() to expose a narrow monitor layout snapshot to GFX pipeline code with framebuffer-derived single-monitor fallback. Backend layout change notification now refreshes server->monitor_layout from the backend before invalidating viewer GFX surfaces. Tests cover multi-monitor server layout copy, primary flag preservation, and single-monitor framebuffer fallback. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, git diff --check, and JSON validation passed.

userStories.title: Send real monitor layout in RDPEGFX ResetGraphics
userStories.description: As a viewer, I want RDPEGFX activation and resize baselines to use the real monitor layout so multi-monitor sessions are represented correctly instead of always sending one spanned monitor.
acceptanceCriteria: viewer_gfx_pipeline_send_snapshot or its replacement builds RDPGFX_RESET_GRAPHICS_PDU with the actual monitor count and monitor definitions from the layout snapshot added in US-003.
Single-monitor sessions still send one primary monitor matching the framebuffer dimensions.
Multi-monitor sessions send all configured monitor rectangles and preserve the primary monitor flag.
Resize/reset baseline sequencing remains ResetGraphics, CreateSurface, MapSurfaceToOutput, StartFrame, SurfaceCommand, EndFrame.
Add tests proving one-monitor and multi-monitor ResetGraphics monitor arrays are built correctly.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: viewer_gfx_pipeline_send_snapshot now builds ResetGraphics from the monitor layout snapshot exposed by US-003. Single-monitor fallback still matches framebuffer dimensions, while multi-monitor server layouts send all monitor definitions and preserve the primary flag. Tests cover fallback monitor count and multi-monitor ResetGraphics monitor arrays. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, git diff --check, and JSON validation passed.

userStories.title: Define safe post-activation GFX failure policy
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want failures after RDPEGFX activation to follow a documented safe policy so OmniRDP does not perform untested mid-session protocol switches that may break clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Choose and document the supported policy for post-activation GFX failures: disconnect/reconnect into classic mode, or in-session classic fallback only for explicitly validated clients.
Update viewer_gfx_pipeline/viewer_server failure paths to follow the documented policy consistently for encoder failure, send failure, ACK timeout, resize/reset failure, and channel failure.
Pre-activation GFX fallback to classic remains per viewer and does not affect unrelated viewers.
Post-activation failure handling must not silently poison other viewers or backend decode.
Add tests for pre-activation fallback and post-activation failure action selection.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: added explicit post-activation RDPEGFX failure policy. Pre-live failures still enter per-viewer classic fallback, while live activated RDPEGFX failures now request viewer disconnect for a clean classic reconnect instead of untested in-session protocol switching. Applied policy to baseline failure, dirty send failure, dirty ACK timeout, live join fallback action, channel open failure, message handling failure, and caps fallback after activation. Added unit tests for pre-activation fallback eligibility, live RDPEGFX disconnect policy, and classic-fallback non-disconnect behavior. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, git diff --check, and JSON validation passed.

userStories.title: Extract pointer transport from viewer_server
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want FreeRDP pointer send calls owned by a pointer transport module so viewer_server.c remains a coordinator rather than a transport implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a focused pointer transport module or extend an existing transport boundary to own PointerSystem, PointerNew, PointerColor, and PointerPosition sends.
viewer_server.c no longer directly calls FreeRDP pointer update send callbacks except through the new narrow transport API.
Existing viewer_pointer planning helpers remain responsible for deciding what pointer updates are needed.
Late-join forced pointer baseline behavior remains unchanged.
Add or update static boundary tests if pointer transport is intended to stay out of viewer_server.c permanently.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: added viewer_pointer_transport.c/.h to own FreeRDP PointerSystem, PointerNew, PointerColor, and PointerPosition sends. viewer_server.c now plans pointer updates and delegates final transport through ViewerPointerTransport instead of directly calling FreeRDP pointer callbacks. Production CMake wiring includes the new module. The final refactor boundary CTest now blocks pointer send callback tokens from returning to viewer_server.c. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, git diff --check, and JSON validation passed.

userStories.title: Restore normal pointer forwarding
userStories.description: As a viewer, I want pointer shape, visibility, and position changes to continue updating after activation so the cursor state stays current, not only correct at late join.
acceptanceCriteria: Clarify in code comments and documentation whether periodic pointer forwarding is required for classic viewers, GFX viewers, or both.
If required, re-enable normal pointer forwarding through the pointer planning and transport APIs without busy-looping or sending unchanged pointer state.
Pointer forwarding uses generation checks so unchanged shape/position are not resent unless forced.
Forced late-join pointer baseline still sends even when generations match.
Add tests for unforced shape change, unforced position change, no-change suppression, and forced baseline behavior.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: restored ongoing pointer forwarding for activated classic and RDPEGFX viewers via viewer_forward_pointer, preserving generation-based no-change suppression and delegated pointer transport sends. Added planner tests for unforced shape-only and position-only updates alongside existing forced baseline and no-change coverage. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, git diff --check, and JSON validation passed.

userStories.title: Implement RFX surface command encoding
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the RFX codec module to build RDPEGFX surface commands from canonical framebuffer snapshots so OmniRDP has its first practical compressed RDPEGFX codec.
acceptanceCriteria: Use FreeRDP 3.26-compatible RFX encoder APIs or documented local wrappers to encode BGRX32 framebuffer snapshots/dirty rectangles into RDPEGFX-compatible RFX/CAVIDEO payloads.
RFX encoding must read from canonical framebuffer snapshots and must not replay backend RDPEGFX PDUs.
The RFX codec owns encoding only and must not own peer/session/virtual-channel sends.
Add unit tests for successful encode, invalid pixel format, invalid rectangle, memory cleanup, and unsupported encoder initialization failure.
Uncompressed codec behavior remains unchanged.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: implemented reusable encode-only ViewerGfxRfxContext owning only FreeRDP RFX_CONTEXT, with RLGR3 BGRX32 deterministic encoder setup, full-frame and dirty-rect CAVIDEO surface command builders, snapshot/rect validation, safe command reset/replacement cleanup, and test hook coverage for encoder init failure. RFX remains unselected by viewer_gfx_pipeline and no caps/config integration was added. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, git diff --check, and JSON validation passed.

userStories.title: Integrate RFX codec selection behind configuration
userStories.description: As an operator, I want RFX RDPEGFX encoding to be selectable only when explicitly configured and supported so clients are never offered codecs OmniRDP cannot encode.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a configuration-controlled viewer GFX codec policy that defaults to the existing uncompressed behavior.
CapsConfirm only confirms RFX-compatible caps when the RFX encoder is available and the configuration allows RFX.
If RFX initialization or encoding fails before activation, the viewer falls back according to the pre-activation fallback policy without affecting other viewers.
If RFX fails after activation, the post-activation failure policy from US-005 is used.
Add tests for default uncompressed selection, explicit RFX selection, unsupported RFX fallback, and no backend caps mirroring.
Typecheck passes
Debug build passes
CTest passes
git diff --check passes
No generated/build artifacts are committed
userStories.notes: Completed: added viewer.gfx.codec preference parsing (uncompressed default, rfx/remote_fx aliases, invalid values default to uncompressed), viewer server codec preference plumbing, per-viewer selected codec state with private RFX context ownership, and pipeline codec dispatch for baseline/dirty RDPEGFX surface commands. Explicit RFX emits CAVIDEO when local encoding succeeds; local RFX init/build failure downgrades that viewer to uncompressed and retries before send. Caps negotiation/backend caps mirroring, config beyond the new key, ClearCodec/H.264/AVC/progressive, and US-012 runtime validation remain unchanged/out of scope. clang-format, Debug build, CTest, git diff --check, and JSON validation passed.
